dealMailLog/$dealId.description: The deal mailer's own note of the last deal status it emailed about, so each change is emailed once. Only the AdPad agent reads or writes it.

dealEscrows/$escrowId.description: AdPad's own escrow for one sponsor booking: one USDC account per escrow, at a public address (getEscrowAddress). The sponsor's wallet locks the money, with or without a creator named yet. The sponsor can take it back until the creator accepts, and can pay the creator at any time; the creator can return it at any time. Either side can dispute after the creator accepts, and only AdPad's agent (AGENT_ADDRESS) decides a dispute. Undisputed money goes back to the sponsor after expiresAt, and an undecided dispute does after ESCROW_DISPUTE_FALLBACK_SECONDS more. ref is the sponsorDeals id. Every change happens through a single-use action under escrows actions.

sponsorCalls/$callId.description: A sponsor's call for creators: what they want promoted, where and by when, with the USDC locked in AdPad's escrow (dealEscrows) before any creator is named. The escrow is created first with no payee and the id of the booking a pick will create as its ref; the call opens once that escrow is locked. Creators respond under responses; the sponsor assigns the escrow to one of them and creates that booking (sponsorDeals, with this call's id as listingId), which then runs as any booking. The sponsor closes the call after taking the USDC back. Calls are public; they ring nobody, the resulting booking rings the agent. See docs/calls.md.
